title: Fingerprint state document
description: The whole of the shipper's local upload state: state/fingerprints.json, replaced atomically on every commit (write-temp + fsync + rename) under the process flock. Authoritative for upload progress -- no backend tracks it. A rejected or wiped document is cheap by design: everything re-uploads once onto its existing path-derived keys. state_schema is checked on load and a mismatch is rejected, never guessed at.

state_schema.description: Document version. A value this client does not know means downgrade or corruption: reject and rebuild.

install_id.description: The install this state belongs to. Present so a state file that travels with the wrong identity unit is detectable rather than silently adopted.

updated_at.description: When this document was last replaced, UTC.

source_specs.description: Per source, the spec fingerprint its entries were recorded under: a hash over only the spec fields that affect how bytes are read (root, glob, primitive), never the global config_version -- an unrelated push must not re-ship history. A mismatch with the current spec drops that source's entries so it re-ships under the new reading.

checksum.description: Hash over every other field, computed with this one cleared. The schema proves the document's shape; this proves its values. A source_hash corrupted in place still parses and reads as a completed ship, which is silent permanent loss -- the store's "a lost document only costs a re-ship" argument covers forgetting a ship, never falsely remembering one. Absent on documents written before this field existed; they earn one on the next rewrite.

entries.description: One entry per (source_id, native_path). Kept sorted by that key so the serialized document is deterministic.

source_id.description: Catalog source that discovered the file.

native_path.description: Absolute path of the source file as read. Local state only -- on the wire the path exists solely inside the age-encrypted manifest.

source_spec_fingerprint.description: Legacy: older builds recorded the spec generation on every entry. Read to seed source_specs, never written.

source_size.description: Size at the last commit. Cheap pre-filter only.

source_mtime.description: Mtime at the last commit. Cheap pre-filter only -- one measured session produced 107 new-mtime, byte-identical files.

source_hash.description: sha256 of the raw pre-redaction bytes last shipped. The authority for change detection and the ETL dedupe identity together with the path.

sink_etag.description: Legacy: builds with a conditional write path persisted the last verified PUT's ETag here. Read-tolerated so an existing document still loads, never written -- the upload path is unconditional and the local fingerprint is the only progress authority.

output_hash.description: Hash of the enricher's deterministic output. The change signal for a derived object: equal hash means no re-ship.

attempts.description: Consecutive failed attempts on this file. Drives the backoff that keeps one unreadable file from consuming the run budget on every tick; reset to zero the moment the file is handled successfully.

parked.description: True when an anomaly halted this entry (a 412 on overwrite, a scrub engine error). Cleared by operator action or a successful run after backoff; never by an unconditional retry.

last_error.description: Human-readable reason the entry parked. Never carries payload content or a redacted value.

backoff_until.description: Earliest next attempt for a parked or failing entry. Exponential with jitter, capped at one hour, no max-retry.
